잠언-26-1.title: 잠언 26장 1절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-1.exegesis: 28. Such are exposed to the incursions of evil thoughts and successful temptations.
잠언-26-1.theologicalNote: 28. Such are exposed to the incursions of evil thoughts and successful temptations.

잠언-26-2.title: 잠언 26장 2절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 26 Pr 26:1-28 . 1. The incongruities of nature illustrate also those of the moral world. The fool's unworthiness is also implied ( Pr 17:7 ; 19:10 ).
잠언-26-2.theologicalNote: CHAPTER 26 Pr 26:1-28 . 1. The incongruities of nature illustrate also those of the moral world. The fool's unworthiness is also implied ( Pr 17:7 ; 19:10 ).

잠언-26-3.title: 잠언 26장 3절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-3.exegesis: 2. Though not obvious to us, the bird-- literally, "sparrow"--and swallow-- have an object in their motions, so penal evil falls on none without a reason.
잠언-26-3.theologicalNote: 2. Though not obvious to us, the bird-- literally, "sparrow"--and swallow-- have an object in their motions, so penal evil falls on none without a reason.

잠언-26-4.title: 잠언 26장 4절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-4.exegesis: 3. The rod is as much needed by fools and as well suited to them, as whips and bridles are for beasts.
잠언-26-4.theologicalNote: 3. The rod is as much needed by fools and as well suited to them, as whips and bridles are for beasts.

잠언-26-5.title: 잠언 26장 5절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-5.exegesis: 4-5. Answer not-- that is, approvingly by like folly.
잠언-26-5.theologicalNote: 4-5. Answer not-- that is, approvingly by like folly.

잠언-26-6.title: 잠언 26장 6절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-6.exegesis: 4-5. Answer not-- that is, approvingly by like folly.
잠언-26-6.theologicalNote: 4-5. Answer not-- that is, approvingly by like folly.

잠언-26-7.title: 잠언 26장 7절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-7.exegesis: 6. A fool fails by folly as surely as if he were maimed. drinketh damage-- that is, gets it abundantly ( Job 15:16 ; 34:7 ).
잠언-26-7.theologicalNote: 6. A fool fails by folly as surely as if he were maimed. drinketh damage-- that is, gets it abundantly ( Job 15:16 ; 34:7 ).

잠언-26-8.title: 잠언 26장 8절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-8.exegesis: 7. legs ... equal-- or, "take away the legs," or "the legs ... are weak." In any case the idea is that they are the occasion of an awkwardness, such as the fool shows in using a parable or proverb (see Introduction; Pr 17:7 ).
잠언-26-8.theologicalNote: 7. legs ... equal-- or, "take away the legs," or "the legs ... are weak." In any case the idea is that they are the occasion of an awkwardness, such as the fool shows in using a parable or proverb (see Introduction; Pr 17:7 ).

잠언-26-9.title: 잠언 26장 9절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-9.exegesis: 8. A stone, bound in a sling, is useless; so honor, conferred on a fool, is thrown away.
잠언-26-9.theologicalNote: 8. A stone, bound in a sling, is useless; so honor, conferred on a fool, is thrown away.

잠언-26-10.title: 잠언 26장 10절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-10.exegesis: 9. As vexatious and unmanageable as a thorn in a drunkard's hand is a parable to a fool. He will be as apt to misuse is as to use it rightly.
잠언-26-10.theologicalNote: 9. As vexatious and unmanageable as a thorn in a drunkard's hand is a parable to a fool. He will be as apt to misuse is as to use it rightly.

잠언-26-11.title: 잠언 26장 11절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-11.exegesis: 10. Various versions of this are proposed (compare Margin). Better perhaps-- "Much He injures (or literally, "wounds") all who reward," &c., that is, society is injured by encouraging evil men. transgressors-- may be rendered "vagrants." The word "God" is improperly supplied.
잠언-26-11.theologicalNote: 10. Various versions of this are proposed (compare Margin). Better perhaps-- "Much He injures (or literally, "wounds") all who reward," &c., that is, society is injured by encouraging evil men. transgressors-- may be rendered "vagrants." The word "God" is improperly supplied.

잠언-26-12.title: 잠언 26장 12절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-12.exegesis: 11. returneth ... folly-- Though disgusting to others, the fool delights in his folly.
잠언-26-12.theologicalNote: 11. returneth ... folly-- Though disgusting to others, the fool delights in his folly.

잠언-26-13.title: 잠언 26장 13절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-13.exegesis: 12. The self-conceited are taught with more difficulty than the stupid.
잠언-26-13.theologicalNote: 12. The self-conceited are taught with more difficulty than the stupid.

잠언-26-17.title: 잠언 26장 17절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-17.exegesis: 16. The thoughtless being ignorant of their ignorance are conceited.
잠언-26-17.theologicalNote: 16. The thoughtless being ignorant of their ignorance are conceited.

잠언-26-18.title: 잠언 26장 18절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-18.exegesis: 17. meddleth-- as in Pr 20:19 ; 24:21 ; as either holding a dog by the ears or letting him go involves danger, so success in another man's strife or failure involves a useless risk of reputation, does no good, and may do us harm.
잠언-26-18.theologicalNote: 17. meddleth-- as in Pr 20:19 ; 24:21 ; as either holding a dog by the ears or letting him go involves danger, so success in another man's strife or failure involves a useless risk of reputation, does no good, and may do us harm.

잠언-26-21.title: 잠언 26장 21절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-21.exegesis: 20-21. The talebearers foster ( Pr 16:28 ), and the contentious excite, strife.
잠언-26-21.theologicalNote: 20-21. The talebearers foster ( Pr 16:28 ), and the contentious excite, strife.

잠언-26-22.title: 잠언 26장 22절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-22.exegesis: 20-21. The talebearers foster ( Pr 16:28 ), and the contentious excite, strife.
잠언-26-22.theologicalNote: 20-21. The talebearers foster ( Pr 16:28 ), and the contentious excite, strife.

잠언-26-24.title: 잠언 26장 24절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-24.exegesis: 23. Warm professions can no more give value to insincerity than silver coating to rude earthenware.
잠언-26-24.theologicalNote: 23. Warm professions can no more give value to insincerity than silver coating to rude earthenware.

잠언-26-25.title: 잠언 26장 25절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-25.exegesis: 24. dissembleth-- though an unusual sense of the word (compare Margin), is allowable, and better suits the context, which sets forth hypocrisy.
잠언-26-25.theologicalNote: 24. dissembleth-- though an unusual sense of the word (compare Margin), is allowable, and better suits the context, which sets forth hypocrisy.

잠언-26-26.title: 잠언 26장 26절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-26.exegesis: 25. Sentiment of Pr 26:24 carried out. seven abominations in his heart-- that is, very many (compare Pr 24:16 ).
잠언-26-26.theologicalNote: 25. Sentiment of Pr 26:24 carried out. seven abominations in his heart-- that is, very many (compare Pr 24:16 ).

잠언-26-27.title: 잠언 26장 27절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-27.exegesis: 26-27. Deceit will at last be exposed, and the wicked by their own arts often bring on retribution (compare Pr 12:13 ; Psa 7:16 ; 9:17 , &c.).
잠언-26-27.theologicalNote: 26-27. Deceit will at last be exposed, and the wicked by their own arts often bring on retribution (compare Pr 12:13 ; Psa 7:16 ; 9:17 , &c.).

잠언-26-28.title: 잠언 26장 28절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-26-28.exegesis: 26-27. Deceit will at last be exposed, and the wicked by their own arts often bring on retribution (compare Pr 12:13 ; Psa 7:16 ; 9:17 , &c.).
잠언-26-28.theologicalNote: 26-27. Deceit will at last be exposed, and the wicked by their own arts often bring on retribution (compare Pr 12:13 ; Psa 7:16 ; 9:17 , &c.).
